option_relations.rationale: Atopic dermatitis does not typically present with psoriasiform epidermal hyperplasia or the specific hair findings described
Pityriasis rubra pilaris is characterized by distinct clinical and histological features not described in the vignette
Netherton syndrome is a rare condition that can present with psoriasiform dermatitis and trichorrhexis invaginata, similar to the findings in the vignette
Ichthyosis linearis circumflexa is a distinct condition with characteristic clinical features not described in the vignette
